title: Generation · EIA-860 · county
description: Net summer capacity of the operating generators listed in Form EIA-860, summed by county, with the number of those generators and of their plants. A county where EIA-860 lists no operating generator has the value 0. Alaska and Hawaii are not processed and have empty values.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: fips
fields.description: County FIPS code, 5 digits, kept as a string (leading zeros matter).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name as published in the boundaries release.

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: net_summer_capacity_mw

null_meaning.not_covered: The county is in Alaska or Hawaii, which this release does not cover; it was not processed.

fields.description: Sum of the net summer capacity of the operating generators (status OP) located in the county. 0 means EIA-860 lists no operating generator in this county.

fields.name: n_op_generators

null_meaning.not_covered: The county is in Alaska or Hawaii, which this release does not cover; it was not processed.

fields.description: Number of operating generators (status OP) in the county. 0 means none are listed. A generator without an ID in the source is not counted (see known gaps).

fields.name: n_op_plants

null_meaning.not_covered: The county is in Alaska or Hawaii, which this release does not cover; it was not processed.

fields.description: Number of plants with at least one operating generator in the county. 0 means none are listed.

coverage.geography: Contiguous United States and the District of Columbia
known_gaps: Alaska and Hawaii are not covered.
Generators that entered service after the end of the edition year are not included.
Three offshore wind plants (171.3 MW in total) are not assigned to any county, so they are not in the county values.
Form EIA-860 covers power plants with a combined nameplate capacity of 1 MW or more. Emergency and standby generators at data centers and other buildings are generally not reported to it.

One operating generator has no generator ID in the source (Cranberry Point Energy Storage, plant 62844, Massachusetts, 150 MW). Its capacity is in the county value, but it is not counted in n_op_generators.

verification.method: Values are computed by script from the source tables: operating generators are located by the coordinates of their plants and summed by county. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 3,144 USA ADM2 units of the boundaries release; 3,109 are covered and 35 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.

The OP capacity total of the source workbook for the listed states was recomputed (1254379.4 MW) and equals the layer total (1254208.1 MW) plus the recorded exceptions (171.3 MW: offshore: Block Island Wind Farm, South Fork Wind, CVOW Pilot 171.3).
